2.name: The First Line of Defense? The Giant Whale Laboon Appears!
2.overview: Upon entering the Grand Line, the ship is swallowed by a giant whale, inside of which they discover a strange place. In addition, they are not the only ones there.

2.name: A Promise Between Men! Luffy and the Whale Vow to Meet Again!
2.overview: After hearing the story of Laboon the whale, Luffy comes up with a clever solution to his problems. From Laboon's caretaker, Crocus, the crew learns more about the Grand Line and how to navigate through it, since compasses are useless there.

2.name: A Town that Welcomes Pirates? Setting Foot on Whisky Peak!
2.overview: Luffy and friends arrive at Whisky Peak, a town of pirate-lovers who hold them a feast.

2.name: Explosion! The Three Swords Style! Zoro vs. Baroque Works!
2.overview: Zoro battles a hundred members of Baroque Works, and discovers there is more to them than meets the eye.

2.name: All Out Battle! Luffy vs. Zoro, Mysterious Grand Duel!
2.overview: Luffy, who does not realize the town is full of bounty hunters, engages in a battle with Zoro after he discovers that Zoro attacked the townsfolk, while Mr. 5 and Miss Valentine head for Princess Vivi.

2.name: Deliver Princess Vivi! The Luffy Pirates Set Sail!
2.overview: Luffy's crew manages to become targets of Crocodile, one of the Shichibukai, and decide to help Princess Vivi. They also meet Miss All-Sunday, the second strongest member of Baroque Works and partner of Crocodile.

2.name: Try Hard, Coby! Coby and Helmeppo's Struggles in the Marines!
2.overview: As Luffy and his crew are sailing in the Grand Line, Koby and Helmeppo are stuck doing odd-jobs for the marines back in East Blue, and encounter Vice-Admiral Garp.

2.name: Coby and Helmeppo's Resolve! Vice-Admiral Garp's Parental Affection!
2.overview: Vice Admiral Garp mentors Koby and Helmeppo to become marines.

2.name: An Ancient Island! The Shadow Hiding in Little Garden!
2.overview: Luffy and friends land on Little Garden, a prehistoric island inhabited by dinosaurs and giants.

2.name: Huge Duel! The Giants Dorry and Broggy!
2.overview: Nami and Usopp meet a giant named Brogy, while Luffy and Vivi encounter Brogy's rival, Dorry. The Straw Hats little suspect that Officer Agents of Baroque Works are on their tail.

2.name: Luffy Gets Angry! A Dirty Trick Violates the Sacred Duel!
2.overview: Dorry, critically injured by exploding ale, blames the Straw Hats. Luffy is enraged that someone would pull such a cowardly trick to sabotage the giants' honorable duel.

2.name: Broggy's Bitter Tears of Victory! The Conclusion of Elbaf!
2.overview: Luffy tries in vain to convince the injured Dorry not to fight Brogy. The Officer Agents who sabotaged Dorry's ale further tamper with the giants' duel.

2.name: The Devilish Candle! Tears of Regret and Tears of Anger!
2.overview: Having subdued the giants, Baroque Works makes their move. Mr. 3 introduces Zoro, Nami, Vivi, and Brogy to the slow torture of becoming living statues of wax.

2.name: A Hex on Luffy! Colors Trap!
2.overview: Luffy attempts to rescue his friends but only accelerates the deadly waxing process. To make matters worse, Miss Goldenweek interferes and reveals her own terrifying ability.

2.name: Time to Fight Back! Usopp’s Quick Thinking and Fire Star!
2.overview: Usopp frees Luffy from Miss Goldenweek's control. With Karoo's help, Usopp and Luffy rescue the others, who take on Mr. 5 and Miss Valentine. Luffy and Karoo pursue Mr. 3 and Miss Goldenweek into the forest.

2.name: Farewell Giant Island! Head for Alabasta!
2.overview: After having a pleasant chat with Mr. 0 and encountering the "Unluckies", Sanji retrieves an Eternal Pose for Alabasta. The crew leaves Little Garden and sets sail for Alabasta.

3.name: Nami's Sick? Beyond the Snow Falling on the Sea!
3.overview: Nami is sick, but the crew doesn't have a doctor to help her.

3.name: A Raid! The Tin Tyrant and Tin Plate Wapol!
3.overview: While looking for a doctor, the crew meets the pirate Wapol, who attacks them, but only makes Luffy send him flying. Meanwhile Smoker manages to intercept the conversation between Mr. 0 and Sanji and plans to go to Alabasta. Back with the crew they arrive at last to an island only to find out they're not welcome.

3.name: An Island without Doctors? Adventure in a Nameless Land!
3.overview: The Straw Hat crew manages to gain the trust of the people that attacked them, and are taken to the village, except for Zoro and Carue, who guard the ship. Luffy and Sanji must take Nami to the island's sole doctor who lives on a mountain-top. Vivi and Usopp discover the past of the island, and about the pirate Wapol from Dalton.

3.name: Are You Happy? The Doctor Called Witch!
3.overview: While Sanji and Luffy fight off the wilderness, the islander's worst nightmare turns true, as Wapol returns to the island. The doctor is discovered to be on the other side of the island, and Usopp, Vivi and Dalton rush to find her. Dalton however returns as he hears of Wapol's return.

3.name: Dalton's Resolve! Wapol's Corps Lands on the Island!
3.overview: Dalton faces Wapol, but only gets himself hit by arrows thrown by his former comrade Chess. An avalanche stops the battle, but injures Sanji. Luffy must carry both Nami and Sanji to the doctor, and begins his ascent.

3.name: The Island Where Snow Lives! Climb the Drum Rockies!
3.overview: The Lapahn help Luffy escape from Wapol, giving him enough time to climb to the castle where doctor Kureha lives. Vivi, Usopp and Zoro deal with the king's army in order to save Dalton. The recovering Nami meets a strange creature.

3.name: Blue-nosed Reindeer! Chopper's Secret!
3.overview: Nami asks Chopper to join the crew, but he isn't interested. Kureha tells Nami some of what was Chopper's background. After realizing the abilities that Chopper has, Luffy is eager to make him join the crew.

3.name: An Outcast's Dream! Hiriluk the Quack!
3.overview: Doctorine continues to tell how Chopper lived his life and how the quack doctor Hiruluk took care of him.

3.name: Hiriluk's Cherry Blossoms and the Will that Gets Carried On!
3.overview: More of Chopper's past is revealed, including the fate of doctor Hiruluk and Wapol's cruelties as the king. Meanwhile, Wapol reaches the castle where the crew is residing.

3.name: Fight Wapol's Crew! The Power of the Munch Munch Fruit!
3.overview: Wapol is determined to bring down Hiruluk's flag, and to do that, he engages Sanji, Luffy and Chopper in a fight.

3.name: Zoan-type Devil Fruit! Chopper's Seven-form Transformation!
3.overview: Chopper demonstrates the abilities of Rumble Balls when fighting Chessmarimo. Dalton is uncovered from the avalanche.

3.name: When the Kingdom's Rule Ends! The Flag of Faith Flies Forever!
3.overview: After trying every trick in the castle, Wapol is finally hunted down by Luffy. The villagers along with Zoro, Vivi and Usopp start their ascent to the castle through a ropeway.

3.name: Hiriluk's Cherry Blossoms! Miracle in the Drum Rockies!
3.overview: After finally been convinced to join the team, Chopper announces his intentions to Dr. Kureha, who doesn't take it too well; but after escaping from the castle, she has decided to give the whole Straw Hat crew a farewell gift.

3.name: Goodbye Drum Island! I'm Going Out to Sea!
3.overview: Chopper joins the Straw Hat crew as they continue their journey to Vivi's homeland.

4.name: Alabasta's Hero and a Ballerina on the Ship!
4.overview: Crocodile appears to stop rampaging pirates. Luffy and his crew meet Mr.  2 Bon Clay who shows off his devil fruit power and Vivi sees a shocking  sight.

4.name: Off to the Desert Kingdom! The Rain-Summing Powder and the Rebel Army!
4.overview: Luffy separates from the rest of the crew, right after arriving at  Alabasta's port city of Nanohana. The crew dons disguises while Luffy  learns of Dance Powder.

4.name: The Heroes Reunion! His Name is Fire Fist Ace!
4.overview: While in Nanohana, the Straw Hats encounter Smoker and Tashigi. A powerful pirate named Portgas D. Ace appears.

4.name: Ace and Luffy! Hot Emotions and Brotherly Bonds!
4.overview: Ace fights Smoker while the Straw Hats run for their ship. Luffy  reunites with his brother, who has joined the Whitebeard Pirates after  leaving home, and is searching for a former crewmate named Blackbeard  who killed a fellow member.

4.name: Erumalu, The City of Green and the Kung Fu Dugongs!!
4.overview: Ace decides to travel with the Straw Hats, as he is hunting for a man known as Blackbeard.

4.name: Adventure in the Country of Sand! The Monsters that Live in the Scorching Land!
4.overview: After leaving Erumalu, the Straw Hats plus Vivi & Ace continue through the desert, facing the many dangers of it.

4.name: Enter the Desert Pirates! The Men Who Live Freely!
4.overview: Nami and Vivi found themselves an easier way to travel in the desert and leave all men behind.

4.name: False Fortitude! Camu, Rebel Soldier at Heart!
4.overview: After hearing that a small village has fake Rebel Army bodyguards that  have been keeping peace, Vivi asks the men of the crew to test if  they're worthy of staying.

4.name: Rebel Warrior Koza! The Dream Vowed to Vivi!
4.overview: Still trekking through the Alabasta desert, the crew beats up a giant  desert scorpion for lunch, while Vivi tells Nami about her past and her  friendship with Kohza.

4.name: Showdown in a Heat Haze! Ace vs. the Gallant Scorpion!
4.overview: Ace fights against a bounty hunter, who claims to have defeated  Blackbeard, although this was a lie to lure Ace out and challenge him in  order to inspire his children to follow their dreams.

4.name: Ruins and Lost Ways! Vivi, Her Friends, and the Country's Form!
4.overview: Zoro, Chopper and Luffy manage to get themselves lost and stumble across some huge underground ruins.

4.name: Spiders Café at 8 o'Clock! The Enemy Leaders Gather!
4.overview: Baroque Works plan starts to take effect, and for that, the Number Agents gather to meet Mr. 0. Meanwhile, the crew finds out that the Rebel Army has moved out of Yuba and headed to Katorea, and the rebel leader Kohza is determined to attack.

4.name: Luffy vs. Vivi! The Tearful Vow to Put Friends on the Line!
4.overview: In Yuba, Luffy learns that Toto was entrusted by Cobra to watch over the land and figures out a way to stop the sandstorm.

4.name: The Battlefront of Alabasta! Rainbase, the City of Dreams!
4.overview: After the struggle, Vivi decides to go after Crocodile with the Straw  Hats. The crew travels to the city of Rainbase, but run afoul of Smoker  and Tashigi.

4.name: The Trap of Certain Defeat! Storming Raindinners!
4.overview: Most of the Straw Hats, along with Smoker, are trapped by Crocodile.  Vivi reunites with the royal guardian Pell, but is captured by Miss  All-Sunday. Crocodile reveals his invincible Devil Fruit power.

4.name: Operation Utopia Commences! The Swell of Rebellion Stirs!
4.overview: Baroque Works' plan to take over Alabasta is set in motion.

4.name: The Terrifying Banana Gators and Mr. Prince!
4.overview: Most of the Straw Hats are helplessly trapped as Vivi tries desperately  to get the key to their cage. but fails. Crocodile is contacted by  someone known as "Mr. Prince."

4.name: The Key to a Great Comeback Escape! The Wax-Wax Ball!
4.overview: The identity of "Mr. Prince" is revealed.

4.name: Merciless Mortal Combat! Luffy vs. Crocodile!
4.overview: After escaping from Rain Dinners, the Straw Hats and Vivi cross the desert to Alubarne, where the final battle will take place.

4.name: Dash For a Miracle! Alabasta Animal Land!
4.overview: Luffy is left for dead by Crocodile, but is helped by the mysteríous  Miss All-Sunday. The rest of the Straw Hats reach Alubarna.

4.name: Rebel Army vs. Royal Army! Showdown at Alubarna!
4.overview: The revolution is on the verge of starting and the crew comes out with a plan that could stop it.

4.name: Alubarna Grieves! The Fierce Captain Karoo!
4.overview: Vivi tries to call out to the Rebel Army, but fails because of a Baroque Works infiltrator in the Royal Army interferes.

4.name: Sworn on a Friend's Dream! The Battle of Molehill, Block 4!
4.overview: Things look hopeless for Usopp & Chopper as they continue to suffer from every attack that the Mr.4 team makes. However, the tides may be beginning to turn as Usopp learns what it truly means to be a man.

4.name: Big Opening Day Today! The Copy-Copy Montage!
4.overview: Albeit severely beaten and bruised, Usopp and Chopper have finally defeated the Mr.4 team. However, Mr. 2 has figured out Sanji's weakness.

4.name: Transformed into Nami! Bon Clay's Rapid-Fire Ballet Kenpo!
4.overview: Though Mr. 2 discovers Sanji's weakness, Sanji still defeats his opponent after an evenly-matched fight. Meanwhile, before Vivi could give the word to blow up the palace, Crocodile appears.

4.name: Nami's Cyclone Advisory! Clima Takt Burst!
4.overview: Nami faces off against Miss Doublefinger and tries to figure out her new weapon that Usopp made, the Clima-Tact.

4.name: Secret Passed Down in the Royal Family! The Ancient Weapon Pluton!
4.overview: While Crocodile reveals to Vivi about the ancient weapon Pluton, Nami attempts to defeat Miss Doublefinger with her most powerful attack: The Tornado Tempo.

4.name: Secret of Powerful Swordplay! Ability to Cut Steel and the Rhythm Things Have!
4.overview: While Miss. Doublefinger's fight with Nami was challenging, Zoro is having an even more difficult time fighting Mr.1: A man who can change his entire body into steel - something that Zoro cannot cut. As Zoro nears death, he must discover the secret to "the breath of all things".

4.name: The Battle is Over! Koza Raises the White Flag!
4.overview: When Vivi reveals Crocodile's plan to Koza, he attempts to stop the fighting, but is shot. Crocodile reveals that he has set up a massive bomb in the city.

4.name: Where Vivi's Voice Gets Heard! The Hero Descends!
4.overview: As Koza tries to stop the Rebel Army, both sides are once more fighting due to the intervention of Baroque Works. Vivi is thrown to her certain death when Luffy saves her and challenges Crocodile to a second round.

4.name: Sand Croc and Water Luffy! The Second Round of the Duel
4.overview: Luffy fights Crocodile with more success this time by using water, but still loses this round. Meanwhile, the other Straw Hats hurry to locate the bomb before it goes off. Nico Robin forces the king to take her to the tomb where the Pluton Poneglyph is hidden.

4.name: That Looks Croc-ish! Luffy, Run to the Royal Tomb!
4.overview: Crocodile joins Robin in the tomb, and orders her to translate the Poneglyph. Robin tells him that Pluton was not mentioned and that it was only about history, but Crocodile figures out that she was lying and stabs her in response. When Luffy recovers from the last round of fighting, he chases after Crocodile into the tomb.

4.name: The Nightmare Draws Near! This is the Sand-Sand Clan's Secret Base!
4.overview: Luffy fights with Crocodile by using blood on his fists. Meanwhile Vivi finds the bomb, and calls the Straw Hats together.

4.name: Magnificent Wings! My Name is Pell, Guardian Deity of the Country!
4.overview: Vivi finds the bomb inside of the clock tower, but the Mr. 7 pair of Baroque Works are there to protect it. Vivi defeats them, but she realizes the bomb cannot be stopped so easily. It has a timer, and right before it blows up, Pell shows up and takes it into the atmosphere, where he sacrifices himself to save Alabasta.

4.name: I Will Surpass You! Rain Falls in Alabasta!
4.overview: Luffy defeats Crocodile by punching him through solid bedrock. When Crocodile falls, the rain-drops calm the soldiers.

4.name: A Farewell to Arms! Pirates and Different Ideas of Justice!
4.overview: Now that the battle has ended, the outcome is tallied. Igaram appears with proof of Cobra's innocence, as well as Koza telling everything. Tashigi and Smoker both are rewarded for taking on Crocodile, but neither one of them believes that is right, considering the Straw Hat pirates did all the work.

4.name: The Pirates' Banquet and Operation Escape from Alabasta!
4.overview: Luffy is rescued from the collapsed tomb where he fought Crocodile and brought into Cobra's palace to rest. When he awakens, a magnificent banquet is thrown for the pirates, then, the Straw Hats are invited to enjoy the hot spring steam room inside the palace.

4.name: It All Started On That Day! Vivi Tells the Story of Her Adventure!
4.overview: It's the day for Vivi's speech and her decision whether or not to continue to be with the Straw Hats. Meanwhile, Bon Kurei and his crew attempt to protect the Straw Hats from Hina.

4.name: Scent of Danger! The Seventh Member is Nico Robin!
4.overview: The Marines fail again to catch the Straw Hats. After escaping from Marines, Nico Robin (Ms. All Sunday) appears from inside of Straw Hats ship. She manages to persuade the crew to let her join. Pell is seen at the end standing over his own grave.

5.name: The First Patient! The Untold Story of the Rumble Ball!
5.overview: After their adventures in Alabasta, the crew come upon another deserted island and split up tasks amongst themselves. Chopper is left in charge of guarding the ship, and he reminisces about the day he first made the rumble ball and his first patient, Dr. Kureha, while spending some time with the newest crewmember: Nico Robin.

5.name: Uprising of the Navigator! For the Unyielding Dream!
5.overview: A weird salesman is fished out of the water and onto the Going Merry, and Nami buys a ton of "1000 year paper" from him to draw her sea maps. However, that's not going to be easy with the rest of the crew goofing off as usual.

5.name: A Recipe Handed Down! Sanji, the Iron Man of Curry!
5.overview: The Going Merry runs into several Marine ships in some fog, and the Straw Hats meet a trainee Marine chef named Tajiyo. Sanji helps him out of a bit of cooking trouble.

5.name: I Will Make it Bloom! Usopp, the Man, and the Eight-Foot Shell!
5.overview: The crew stops on an island that's having its annual fireworks festival; Usopp meets a young fireworks-maker named Kodama and helps her achieve her dream.

5.name: The Fabled Pirate Hunter! Zoro, the Wandering Swordsman!
5.overview: Zoro has a flashback about the time when he first met Johnny and Yosaku, and faced off against Bandits and, Dick.

5.name: Zenny of the Island of Goats and the Pirate Ship in the Mountains!
5.overview: After escaping from several Marine ships, the Straw Hats land on an uncharted island and meet an old man named Zenny. Chopper finds out that, because of his bad heart, Zenny probably only has three days to live.

5.name: How's Tricks? The Designs of Zenny the Moneylender!
5.overview: The Straw Hats help Zenny out, hoping to make his last days good ones; they learn about Zenny's past as a money lender, and his dream of becoming a pirate. But Zoro realizes that Zenny has outlived Chopper's predictions and so the straw hats decide that, after helping him finish his pirate ship, they will leave the island.

5.name: Whereabouts of the Island Treasure! Attack of the Zenny Pirates!
5.overview: Zenny decides to follow his dream and become a pirate, despite his age. He helps the Straw Hats out of trouble with the Marines, and then they part ways.

5.name: Legend of the Rainbow Mist! Old Man Henzo of Luluka Island!
5.overview: On Ruluka Island, some of the Straw Hats make enemies of the Mayor and his men, who have placed high taxes on everything. Robin, Usopp, and Luffy meet Professor Henzo, who's doing research on the island's rainbow mist. When some of the mist shows up, Henzo borrows the Going Merry to go explore it.

5.name: Residents of the Land of Eternity! The Pumpkin Pirates!
5.overview: The inside of the Rainbow Mist full of wrecked ships and treasure, and is guarded by five kids. The kids are actually friends of Henzo's that got lost in the mist over 50 years ago.

5.name: Thoughts of Home! The Pirate Graveyard of No Escape!
5.overview: Henzo, his friends, and the others try to find a way out of the ship graveyard. Meanwhile, the Mayor and his men let the information about the Rainbow Mist slip to the remaining Straw Hats still on Ruluka.

5.name: An Inevitable Melee! Wetton's Schemes and the Rainbow Tower!
5.overview: Luffy accidentally propels himself and Rapanui to the end of the mist. Nami appears in the ship graveyard with a rowboat full of treasure and a string connected to the real world, which are both stolen by Wetton's subordinate. The Mayor uses the Rainbow Tower to make a bridge to the Rainbow Mist.

5.name: And so, the Legend Begins! To the Other Side of the Rainbow!
5.overview: The Going Merry escapes from the Rainbow Mist, getting badly damaged on the way. The Mayor gets arrested by a bunch of powerful marines that turn out to be older versions of Henzo's friends, who were thrown 50 years into the past by the Rainbow Mist's collapse.

6.name: The Log is Taken! Salvage King, Masira!
6.overview: Nami's log pose begins to point to the sky, and the crew finds a map of an island named 'Skypiea' on a 200-year-old ship. They compete with the monkey-like Masira's salvage crew while they search for more clues on how to get there.

6.name: Monsters Appear! Don't Mess with the Whitebeard Pirates!
6.overview: The Straw Hats decide to go to Jaya island to look for information on Skypeia. Meanwhile, Ace suddenly shows up on Buggy's ship; Buggy does not let any of his men attack Ace, fearing Whitebeard's retribution.

6.name: Quit Dreaming! Mock Town, the Town of Ridicule!
6.overview: Jaya's main town is full of famous pirates that are constantly brawling with each other. Luffy and Zoro have a run-in with a pirate known as 'Bellamy the Hyena,' who ridicules their dreams and beats them up.

6.name: Distinguished Pirates! A Man Who Talks of Dreams and the King of Undersea Search!
6.overview: After refusing to fight Bellamy, Luffy, Zoro and Nami run into a certain cherry pie lover. They leave Mock Town, and get into a fight with Masira's brother Shoujou, another salvage monkey.

6.name: Legendary Family! Noland, the Liar!
6.overview: The Straw Hats meet with Mont Blanc Cricket on another part of Jaya; Cricket is a descendant of Montblanc Noland, an infamous "liar" who told of a gold city on Jaya, and Cricket was outcast for looking for artifacts of the gold city. He may be the only person who knows how to get to Skypiea.

6.name: Steer for the Clouds! Capture the South Bird!
6.overview: Cricket explains how the Straw Hats can ride a dangerous vertical current called the Knock-Up Stream to get to Skypeia. However, they first have to catch a southbird to point them toward the point where the stream will erupt from the ocean.

6.name: Dreams Don't Come True?! Bellamy Versus the Saruyama Alliance!
6.overview: While the Straw Hats are looking for a Southbird, Bellamy and his crew attack Cricket's house, and steal the gold artifacts he'd collected over the years from his salvage work. When the Straw Hats return and see what happened, Luffy decides to take a side trip back to Mock Town.

6.name: 100 Million Man! World's Greatest Power and Pirate Black Beard!
6.overview: Luffy takes out Bellamy with a single punch. Meanwhile, the world government heads are concerned over Whitebeard, Shanks, and Luffy. The marines try to decide who will replace Crocodile as a Shichibukai - one of Blackbeard's crew shows up uninvited and nominates his captain.

6.name: Take to the Sky! Ride the Knockup Stream!
6.overview: The Going Merry is refitted by Masira and Shoujou to be more flight capable, and the Straw Hats catch a ride on the Knock-Up Stream for Skypeia.

6.name: Sail the White Sea! The Sky Knight and the Gate in the Clouds!
6.overview: The Straw Hats arrive in an ocean above the clouds. Usopp almost falls out of the Going Merry but is saved at the last minute. The crew is also attacked by a mysterious looking warrior, but is saved by the Knight of the Sky. Finally, they arrive at the border which transports them to the upper realm, Skypiea.

6.name: Godland, Skypiea! Angels on a Beach of Clouds!
6.overview: As the crew arrives in Skypiea, they are greeted by Conis and her pet Su. Both she and her father start explaining how the life in Skypiea is and how the different Dials work.

6.name: The Forbidden Sacred Ground! The Island Where God Lives and Heaven's Judgement!
6.overview: Nami finds out what should happen to anyone who enters the forest. Meanwhile, the rest of the gang are waiting for the wind to change but are rudely assaulted by Skypiea's police who are going to carry out Heaven's Judgement.

6.name: Already Criminals?! Skypiea's Upholder of the Law!
6.overview: The Straw Hats have some problems with the local justice enforcer force called "The White Berets."

6.name: Is Escape Possible?!? God's Challenge is Set in Motion
6.overview: While trying to escape from Sky Island, Robin, Chopper, Nami and Zoro are held hostages by God Enel.

6.name: A Trap on Lovely Street! The Almighty Eneru
6.overview: Conis leads Luffy, Usopp, and Sanji to a boat to get to Upper Yard, but she tells them it is a trap and almost gets hit by "Heaven's Judgment".

6.name: Onward Little Crow! To the Sacrificial Altar!
6.overview: Luffy, Usopp and Sanji finally enter Upper Yard, only to find out that the whole road is trapped heavily, but at last they arrive at the Ordeal Gates. Meanwhile Robin, Zoro, and Nami go out to explore Upper Yard while Chopper stays behind to guard the ship.

6.name: 10% Survival Rate! Satori, the Mantra Master!
6.overview: Luffy, Sanji, and Usopp enter the Ordeal of Balls gate and encounter the Priest Satori.

6.name: The Ordeal of Spheres! Desperate Struggle in the Lost Forest!
6.overview: Usopp, Sanji and Luffy fight Satori, but the power of Mantra seems to be too strong.

6.name: Chopper in Danger! Former God vs. Priest Shura!
6.overview: Chopper, threatened by priest Shura, blows the whistle for Gan Fall to come, but before he can arrive, Priest Shura assaults Chopper and begins destroying the Going Merry.

6.name: Profound Mystery! Ordeal of String and Ordeal of Love?!?
6.overview: Gan Fall cannot handle Shura and lost the battle. Meanwhile, Satori is finally defeated by Luffy and Sanji.

6.name: Light the Fire of Shandora! Wyper the Warrior!
6.overview: Chopper is saved by a bunch of giant Southbirds, who tell him that Gan Fall was actually God. Nami, Zoro and Robin discover the reason why Upper Yard is a soil island: It was once part of Jaya, and this is the part that Liar Noland saw. Meanwhile the Shandia attack Upper Yard.

6.name: Jaya, City of Gold in the Sky! Head for God's Shrine!
6.overview: The Shandia attack on Upper Yard has started. The crew is finally reunited, and everyone speaks up about what has happened. Chopper takes care of Gan Fall, and the pirates plan to steal the gold on the island.

6.name: Festival on the Night Before Gold-Hunting! Feelings for "Vearth!"
6.overview: After befriending a wolf pack, Gan Fall tells the crew a little more about the history of Upper Yard.

6.name: Enter God Eneru! Farewell to the Survivors!
6.overview: Enel takes away the limitations of the priests. Also, Usopp witnesses a mysterious person fixing the ship; the next day Merry is found to be back to her original form. After getting her off the altar, the pirates plan out their course of action.

6.name: A Giant Snake Bares Its Fangs! The Survival Game Begins!
6.overview: A giant python makes Luffy, Robin, Chopper and Zoro split while going to the ruins at the south.

6.name: The Deadly Reject! War Demon Wyper's Resolve!
6.overview: Wyper takes out Shura and tells his goal to the Shandia, and Enel speaks up about how many people will be alive by the end of his plan.

6.name: Fierce Mid-Air Battle! Pirate Zoro vs. Warrior Braham!
6.overview: Zoro fights the Shandia warrior Braham, and defeats him with Ittoryu (one sword style) 36 Pound Cannon technique.

6.name: The Roaring Burn Bazooka!! Pirate Luffy vs. War Demon Wyper!
6.overview: Luffy fights Wyper, but after some time, he falls into some underground ruins. Meanwhile, Enel appears on the Going Merry and after telling that his true goal was the City of Gold, he takes out both Usopp and Sanji; then he vanishes and leaves Satori's brothers: Hotori and Kotori to avenge him.

6.name: The Ordeal of Swamp! Chopper vs Priest Gedatsu!
6.overview: Chopper is attacked by Gedatsu, who turns out to be a complete moron, and eventually defeats him, sending him plummeting to the Blue Sea. Conis and Pagaya help Aisa, and head to Upper Yard.

6.name: Unbeatable Powers! Eneru's True Form is Revealed!
6.overview: Enel defeats several members of the Shandia Tribe. Meanwhile, Gan Fall and Nami start and finish their fight with Kotori and Hotori. Hotori is defeated by Nami while Kotori is defeated by Gan Fall.

6.name: A Mystical City! The Grand Ruins of Shandora!
6.overview: While Robin is looking at some ruins she found, Yama, The Chief Enforcer, attacks her. Yama is easily defeated by Robin. Later, she discovers the legendary city, Shandora.

6.name: 0% Survival Rate! Chopper vs. Ohm, the Sword Wielding Priest!
6.overview: Priest Ohm appears and starts fighting everyone.

6.name: Climb Giant Jack! Deadly Combat in the Upper Ruins!
6.overview: At the Upper Ruins, the fight between Ohm, Zoro, Gan Fall and Wyper begins. When Nami appears, she is swallowed by the giant python, along with Gan Fall and Aisa.

6.name: The Ordeal of Iron! White Barbed Death Match!
6.overview: Ohm makes matters worse, creating a barbed wire cage around the area. Laki is knocked out by Enel, and Nami, Aisa, and Gan Fall find out why the python was rampaging so much.

6.name: Bursting Slash! Zoro vs Ohm!
6.overview: Zoro finally defeats Priest Ohm with his 108 Pound Cannon technique. Meanwhile Pagaya and Conis hear the terrible truth about the goal of Enel: to eradicate every person in the sky.

6.name: Collapsing Upper Ruins! The Quintet for the Finale!
6.overview: Enel appears only to reduce the group as close to his prediction as he can.

6.name: Showdown in the Ancient Ruins! Sky God Eneru's Goal!
6.overview: Enel counterattacks Gan Fall and lands a finishing hit. He then knocks out Robin as she tries to manipulate him. Zoro impresses Enel with his power but is easily beaten, while trying to make him pay for what he did to Robin; but it takes Wyper with a secret weapon to take Enel down.

6.name: Ambition Towards the Endless Vearth! The Ark Maxim!
6.overview: Enel defeats Zoro and Wyper. Upon seeing this, Nami follows him to a cave where his ark, Maxim, is. Luffy finally gets out of the snake, along with Aisa, only to find out the outcome of the fight against Enel. When Aisa tells him that she knows where he is, he asks her to take him there.

6.name: They Finally Clash! Pirate Luffy vs God Eneru!
6.overview: Luffy and Enel start fighting. Conis tells the dangers of staying in Sky Island to the other Skypieans.

6.name: Maxim Surfaces! Deathpiea is Activated!
6.overview: The fight between Enel and Luffy continues with Enel starting a machine that would bring the death of Skypiea: Deathpiea.

6.name: Luffy Falls! Eneru's Judgement and Nami's Wish!
6.overview: Luffy falls from the ark. Nami starts fighting Enel while Sanji and Usopp try to rescue her.

6.name: The Two Awaken! On the Front Lines of the Burning Love Rescue!
6.overview: Usopp and Sanji split up to rescue Nami, but the first one to get on deck is Usopp.

6.name: Capriccio for Despair! The Impending Doom of Sky Island!
6.overview: Enel's thunderclouds are coming down to Sky Island while the evacuation is half complete.

6.name: Lead by a Bell's Sound! Tale of the Great Warrior and the Explorer!
6.overview: The history of Noland and Kalgara is told, as a flashback from Wyper.

6.name: Free From the Spell! The Great Warrior Sheads Tears!
6.overview: Noland and Kalgara are enjoying themselves, as well as the villagers and Noland's crew, but that changes one day, as the villagers start hating their new friends.

6.name: Eternal Friends! The Vowed Bell Echoes Across the Mighty Seas!
6.overview: The cause of the hatred is discovered and explained. Meanwhile, Kalgara vows to meet Noland again.

6.name: Angel Island, Obliterated! The Horror of The Raigo's Advent!!
6.overview: Angel Island is destroyed by Enel's attacks. Luffy decides to go and ring the golden bell before Enel takes it away.

6.name: Knock Over Giant Jack! Last Hope for Escape!
6.overview: Nami finds out a way to get to Enel, by cutting down Giant Jack. Wyper finds out from Robin that Noland has a descendant that is searching for the Gold City, and that's the reason why Luffy wants to ring the Golden Bell.

6.name: Miracle on Skypiea! The Love Song Heard in the Clouds!
6.overview: Luffy battles Enel. Battle for Skypiea!

6.name: The Battle Ends! Proud Fantasia Echoes Far!
6.overview: The 400 year war on Sky Island comes to an end. Montblanc Cricket and the Masira Brothers hear the Golden Bell ringing and realize that the Gold City was always in the sky. Enel, who was thrown to the Blue Sea heads out to the Fairy Vearth (the Moon). The Sky People (both Skypieans and Shandia) celebrate the end of the war with a great bonfire.

6.name: I Made it here! The Yarn the Poneglyphs Spin!
6.overview: Robin deciphers the poneglyphs on the Golden Bell and realizes how to find the Rio Poneglyph. She also discovers that the poneglyphs on the Bell were written by Gol D. Roger, who could understand poneglyphs, who had discovered the Rio Poneglyph, and had once visited Skypiea. Soon afterwards, the Straw Hats steal a bunch of gold from the Giant Anaconda's belly and they begin to leave Skypiea.

6.name: Off to the Blue Sea!! A Heartfelt Finale!!
6.overview: The Golden Bell rings as the Straw Hats are going down to the sea, meaning that they are welcome and are deeply thankful for what they did. When the ship finally rests on the sea, problems appear, as the ship has landed in a Marine base.

7.name: A State of Emergency is Issued! A Notorious Pirate Ship has Infiltrated!
7.overview: The Marines are convinced the Going Merry is a ghost ship after it  crashes inside their fortress from above. The crew members are scattered  around the premises.

7.name: Sanji the Cook! Proving His Merit at the Marine Dining Hall!
7.overview: In disguise, Sanji shows the Marine chefs the proper way to prepare a meal.

7.name: Captured Zoro! Chopper's Emergency Operations!
7.overview: Zoro is taken prisoner as Chopper and Nami assist a nervous doctor in treating injured Marines.

7.name: The Marines Dragnet Closes In! The Second Member Captured!
7.overview: Robin and Usopp both disguise themselves as the same visiting inspector,  and Usopp is thrown in the brig with Zoro. Luffy and Sanji are  discovered by Jonathan after a slight mishap.

7.name: Luffy and Sanji's Daring Rescue Mission!
7.overview: The real Inspector is thrown in the brig with Zoro and Usopp, while  Sanji and Luffy race to rescue the two while avoiding detection.

7.name: Enter the Hot-Blooded Special Forces! Battle on the Bridge!
7.overview: Sanji and Luffy, after freeing Usopp and Zoro, try to escape Navarone.  As the Burning Soul combat unit is deployed, Dr. Kobato leads Nami and  Chopper to the docks.

7.name: Breaking Through the Seige! The Going Merry is Recovered!
7.overview: The crew meets at the docks and are surrounded by Marines. Using Nami as their fake hostage, they trick the Marines into letting them back on the Going Merry.

7.name: The Pirate Ship Disappears! Fortress Battle, Round #2!
7.overview: The crew disguises the Going Merry as a Marine ship so they can get their treasure back. With the gold, they decide they’ll hire a shipwright.

7.name: The Gold and Waver Recovery Operations!
7.overview: Usopp splits up the crew into two teams: the gold retrieval team and the waver retrieval team. Inspector Shepherd decides to catch Luffy on his own.

7.name: The One Fell Swoop Plan! Jonathan's Surefire Secret Tactic!
7.overview: Sanji, Zoro, Usopp, and Robin continue to search for their treasure. Luffy leads Nami to the captain’s quarters where they retrieve their gold.

7.name: Farewell, Marine Fortress! The Last Battle for Escape!
7.overview: The Going Merry is grounded during a period of low tide and Jonathan believes they’ve reached “checkmate”. They cleverly use the impact dial to boost the ship and the breath and flame dials to inflate the octopus balloon again so they can escape.

7.name: Great Adventure at Long Ring Long Land!
7.overview: Luffy and company come across a mysterious pirate ship after trying to escape a giant wave. Soon, they arrive on an island inhabited by strange animals. Going Merry is captured by the Foxy Pirate crew.

7.name: A Davy Back with the Foxy Pirates!
7.overview: After Tonjit re-unites with his horse, they are soon attacked by Captain Foxy and his subordinates, who challenge Luffy in a Davy Back Fight, a contest of pirates where the stakes are members of the crew.

7.name: Round 1! One Lap of the Donut Race!
7.overview: The first round of Davy Back Fight involves a race around the island with tiny boats. Zoro's and Chopper's boat is eliminated.

7.name: Silver Fox Foxy! The Merciless Interference!
7.overview: With only Luffy, Nami, and Porche's boat remaining, it's an all out war to the goal, but after Foxy exposes his Devil Fruit powers, Porche wins and takes Tony Tony Chopper from Luffy. The second round prepares to start.

7.name: Round 2! Shoot it into the Groggy Ring!
7.overview: Without Chopper, Sanji and Zoro must face the Foxy Pirates in a ball game, but are hampered by their blatant cheating and the crooked referee.

7.name: A Barrage of Red Cards in Groggy Ring!
7.overview: The bickering rivals Sanji and Zoro manage to overcome the opposing team by working together. Luffy chooses Tonjit's horse, Shelly over Chopper.

7.name: Round 3! The Round-and-Round Roller Race!
7.overview: The Straw Hats face Foxy a race around a giant ring on roller skates.

7.name: A Seriously Heated Race! Into The Final Round!
7.overview: Thanks to to some quick planning, the Straw Hats win the race.

7.name: Screaming-Hot Bombardment! Pirate Dodgeball!
7.overview: With Luffy's victory, he takes Chopper back, but foolishly accepts another challenge by Foxy.

7.name: Showdown on the Cliff! Red Light, Green Light!
7.overview: Foxy decides to take Robin from Luffy this time because of her Devil Fruit ability. The next match is a race to the top of the island.

7.name: The Captains Square Off! The Final Combat Round!
7.overview: With Chopper gone again from Luffy's crew, Luffy and Foxy face off in the final game: a battle of brawn aboard Foxy's ship.

7.name: Full-Blast Slow-Slow Onslaught Vs. Invulnerable Luffy!
7.overview: Luffy continues to battle Foxy with the odds not in his favor, and the fight continues inside Foxy's ship.

7.name: Epic, Heated Combat! The Fateful Final Conclusion!
7.overview: Luffy manages to finally defeat Foxy by using his ability against him. After dismissing his new crewmembers, the Straw Hats leave in search for a shipwright.

7.name: Was It Lost? Stolen? Who Are You?
7.overview: A mysterious figure appears during the night and steals the memories of the crew. In the morning, Robin is the only one who remembers the Straw Hats adventures together. Her attempts to keep the crew together fail as Nami and Zoro go separate ways.

7.name: A Mysterious Boy with a Horn and Robin's Deduction!
7.overview: Robin suggests that only those who were sleeping lost their memories. Luffy and the others then remember seeing the mysterious boy who played some kind of flute. Later that night, they discover the boy outside and Luffy tries to fight him. At the last second, he proclaims his memory has returned.

7.name: Now, Let's Get Back Our Memories! The Pirate Crew Lands on the Island!
7.overview: During the night, Usopp, Chopper, and Sanji question what brought them to the Going Merry. In the morning, Usopp builds them a raft and they sail to the island where they meet Nami again. Meanwhile, the boy sets his sights on Zoro.

7.name: Zoro Bares His Fangs! A Savage Animal Stands in the Way!
7.overview: On their way to "The Palace of the Sea God" Robin's group meets an entranced Zoro. It looks like Zoro wants to fight so Luffy urges the others to keep going without him. They apprehend the kid but the whistle was what was really stealing their memories. Zoro returns, still entranced, but Luffy's nowhere to be seen.

7.name: The Last Counterattack by the Memory Thief Who Reveals His True Colors!
7.overview: Luffy returns and knocks some sense into Zoro. Cornered, the sea horse spreads illusions of the people in their memories to distract them. It steals their complete memories and claims that it has become a Sennenryu. Luffy defeats it and returns all the memories but the townspeople are convinced they are the memory stealers.

7.name: Proud Man! Silver Fox Foxy!
7.overview: Luffy rescues Foxy, Hamburg, and Porche from a storm at sea. When they reunite with the Sexy Foxy ship, they find it captained by somebody new. Foxy accepts a Davy Back Fight in order to regain his ship and crew. Donning the afro once again, Luffy vows to defeat the captain.

7.name: The Guy Who's The Closest To Invincible? And the Most Dangerous Man!
7.overview: Once Foxy wins back his crew, he captures the Straw Hats. Nami and Luffy fight Foxy and although he's defeated, his crew accepts him back. Later, they sail to an island where they meet someone Robin knows: a Marine named Aokiji.

7.name: Marine Headquarters Admiral Aokiji! The Ferocity of an Ultimate Powerhouse!
7.overview: The man they met, Marine High Admiral Aokiji, appears to be incredibly lazy. He first displays his Devil's Fruit ability by freezing the sea so some deserted people can get off the island. Unfortunately, he's determined to catch Robin. Luffy, Sanji, and Zoro attack but they seem to be no match.

7.name: Duel Between Rubber and Ice! Luffy vs. Aokiji!
7.overview: Robin is frozen by Aokiji and Luffy tells the others to escape with her. In the Going Merry, Usopp and Chopper try to thaw her in the shower. Luffy gets defeated (frozen), but his life is spared as Aokiji believes he must repay the debt the marines incurred from Crocodile's defeat at Luffy's hands. With the crew defrosted, they continue sailing as usual. Zoro spots the giant frog they heard about and they chase it to an island with a lighthouse, but it appears they'll sink before they get there.

8.name: The Dashing Sea Train and the City of Water: Water Seven!
8.overview: After the Going Merry narrowly escapes being hit by a "sea train", the crew meets an old woman, Kokoro, and her granddaughter, Chimney. Kokoro gives Luffy a map to Water Seven. Luffy, Nami, and Usopp buy boats driven by sea monsters called "yagara".

8.name: Adventure in the City On the Water! Head to the Mammoth Shipbuilding Plant!
8.overview: Luffy, Nami, and Usopp get strange greetings from the residents and they get to experience the roller coaster-like channels of Water Seven. Luffy find out that some pirates had been beaten at the hands of some powerful craftsmen; the Galley La Company. Chopper loses Robin and some strange new people threaten Zoro back on the ship.

8.name: The Franky Family and Iceberg!
8.overview: The people who attacked Zoro reveal themselves to be the feared "Franky Family", though they're no match for Zoro. Luffy have their gold exchanged for cash. After, they meet a man who resembles Usopp, Galley La's carpenter employment foreman, Kaku. Usopp's cut of the money is stolen by the Franky Family.

8.name: Galley-La Company! A Grand Sight: Dock #1!
8.overview: Paulie makes his debut when he retrieves Usopp's stolen money as he runs from debt collectors. Kalifa shows Luffy, Nami, and Usopp around Dock No. 1 and tells them how Iceburg founded the Galley La Company. Kaku returns from the Going Merry and tells them that their keel is irreparably damaged.

8.name: Pirate Abduction Incident! A Pirate Ship That Can Only Await Her End!
8.overview: Luffy refuses to believe that Galley La cannot repair the Going Merry. The two soon realize that not only is Usopp missing now, but the two brief cases that were returned to them are empty. Nami decides to head to Franky House and finds Usopp on the way in a pitiful state. As she heads back to the ship for help, Usopp goes to the Franky House himself.

8.name: Rescuing Our Friend! Raid on the Franky House!
8.overview: Luffy, Sanji, Zoro, and Chopper follow Usopp's bloody trail to the Franky House, where they find him passed out in front. The four of them challenge the Franky Family only to find out that their real target, Franky himself, is gone and has taken the money with him.

8.name: Big Fight under the Moon! The Pirate Flag Flutters with Sorrow!
8.overview: Once they're back on the ship, Luffy has to finally tell Usopp that the Going Merry can no longer be repaired and that they've chosen to get a new ship without him. Usopp believes that Luffy has abandoned the dignity of their ship and says he's leaving the crew. That night, he challenges Luffy to a duel.

8.name: Luffy vs. Usopp! Collision of Two Men's Pride!
8.overview: Usopp fights Luffy in order to decide who keeps the Going Merry; he fights harder than he's ever fought before. Luffy actually seems to pose no threat but all the while, he's remembering what great friends they used to be, sailing together on the same ship. Even after taking a harsh beating, Luffy defeats Usopp. They leave Usopp and the ship behind.

8.name: Severe Shock Hits the City of Water! Iceberg Targeted!
8.overview: The Strawhats get themselves a hotel room. Nami finds the crew on the roof with urgent news: Iceburg has been shot. As the Galley La Company frantically search for answers, Nami and Luffy decide to check on his condition – only to be met by closed gates. Franky appears then to exact his revenge – with style.

8.name: Gum-Gum Human Vs. Fire-Breathing Cyborg!
8.overview: In the streets outside of the hospital, Luffy fights Franky. Inside, Iceburg recalls seeing Nico Robin and another tall man before he was shot. The Galley La company run outside and stop Franky and Luffy and tell them that they suspect the Strawhat Pirates of the crime.

8.name: The Straw Hat Pirates are the Culprits? The Protectors of the City of Water!
8.overview: The Galley La Company continues to fight Luffy and Franky is enraged that they've stolen his opponent. An incredibly high tide called the "Aqua Laguna" is coming and Chopper and Sanji rush to warn Usopp. Luffy raises some chaos in order to meet with Iceburg and he demands to know what's happening. Iceburg says he wants to see Robin one more time.

8.name: Eternal Farewell? Nico Robin, the Woman Who Draws Darkness!
8.overview: In a bar, Franky talks with Kokoro about her theory on who shot Iceburg. The rumors she speaks of seem to have some truth as we see Robin meeting with someone from an organization called CP9. While the crew hide from angry residents, Sanji and Chopper discover Robin and she tells them what they've feared: she's responsible and she wants to part ways.

8.name: Capture Robin! The Determination of the Straw Hats!
8.overview: Chopper reunites with the others without Sanji and they discuss what's happened. Luffy decides that in order to know the full truth, they must catch Robin. Usopp attempts to repair the ship enough to withstand the Aqua Laguna and the Strawhats make their way to the Galley La Company.

8.name: Cannon Fire Is the Signal! CP9 Goes Into Action!
8.overview: The Strawhats (still missing Sanji) rush to Galley La where Robin and CP9 begin a raid. In Iceburg's room, Robin and the mysterious man Iceburg saw before, tell him that they've purposely placed the blame on the pirates. Their true aim is the blueprints he would've passed down to Paulie. Luffy separates from his group.

8.name: CP9 Takes Off Their Masks! Their Shocking True Faces!
8.overview: Robin speaks with Iceburg inside his room still. We already know that Robin can read the poneglyphs - and it seems Iceburg is the one with the blueprints to the ultimate weapon, Pluton. The true enemies are revealed to be Iceburg's own allies. Elsewhere, Luffy is tied up with Paulie after Paulie tells members of CP9 that his blueprints are fake.

8.name: Secret Bond! Iceberg and Franky!
8.overview: Lucci tells Iceburg their hypothesis and has Kaku check his pulse to tell if the things he tells him are true. They suspect that Iceburg's friend from the past, Cutty Flam, is really Franky and it's revealed to be true. Therefore, Franky has the real blueprints. The Strawhat Pirates and Paulie break into the room where they find Iceburg and CP9.

8.name: Come Back, Robin! Showdown with CP9!
8.overview: Luffy and the others request that Robin comes back to the crew. She refuses and tells them that she cannot accomplish her "wish" if she were to stay with them. Robin turns to leave and CP9 try to hold the pirates back. Robin successfully escapes and Lucci shows those remaining his "transformation".

8.name: The Straw Hat Pirates Annihilated? The Menace of the Leopard Model!
8.overview: Lucci's transformation is a result of a Devil's Fruit; a Zoan Type leopard. He quickly disposes of the crew and CP9 tie up Paulie and Iceburg, leaving them alone as the building slowly burns down around them. In Franky's underground hideout, Usopp tells him his story and Franky is finally touched. In return, Franky tells him a little about Tom's contributions to Water Seven.

8.name: The Man Who Is Loved Even by His Ship! Usopp's Tears!
8.overview: Usopp believes that the person who repaired the Going Merry in Skypeia was really the Going Merry itself. Franky says that the ship was inhabited by a spirit who enters ships who are dearly cared for. The spirit repaired their ship just enough for them to reach the next island. The doorbell rings from the sea side and the Galley La foremen enter.

8.name: Franky's Past! The Day the Sea Train First Ran!
8.overview: The foremen discover Franky's hidden room and he fears they'll trample his memories. A long flashback ensues, covering Franky's past in Tom's Workers and how he and Iceburg helped create the Sea Train.

8.name: Spandam's Scheme! The Day the Sea Train Shook!
8.overview: Spandam, a CP5 representative, was determined to get Tom proven guilty in his trial so he could get the blueprints. As Franky walked into the town, people from the government began to attack with the battleships he had personally constructed. Tom and Iceburg run to their shipyard where they're attacked by two ships which also destroy the others. Iceburg tells Franky that he has to take responsibility or he'll never forgive him.

8.name: The End of the Legendary Man! The Day the Sea Train Cried!
8.overview: Franky said that if a ship of his were to be used as a weapon, then it's no longer one of his ships. That enraged Tom and he punched Franky for the first time, telling him he had to take pride in the ships he created. He then told the judge that he would accept the punishment for both his previous crime and the recent attack. Franky tried to stop the train to Enies Lobby with his bare hands.

8.name: The Truth Behind Her Betrayal! Robin’s Sorrowful Decision!
8.overview: Chopper escapes the burning building with Paulie and Iceburg on his back and collapses outside. Iceburg tells Nami that CP9 threatened to destroy the Straw Hats if Robin didn't cooperate with them. Nami rushes to tell Chopper so they can go looking for the rest of the crew. Elsewhere, the foremen let go of the Going Merry so she would be destroyed at sea.

8.name: The Steam Whistle Forces Friends Apart! The Sea Train Starts to Run!
8.overview: Paulie helps clear the name of the Strawhats but doesn't tell the mob everything he knows. He gets the mob to follow Chopper so they can search for the rest of the crew. Nami goes her own way so she can rush to the Sea Train. As Nami nears the station, Sanji, ahead of her, approaches the train

8.name: Sanji Barges In! Sea Train Battle in the Storm!
8.overview: Nami and the conductors are rescued by Paulie when the Aqua Laguna floods the main station. A man hands Nami a letter he found from Sanji. It informs her that Usopp, Franky, and he are on board the train that had just departed. On board, he storms the cars. High up in the city, Nami speaks with Kokoro and spots Luffy, stuck in between two buildings, in the back streets where the Aqua Laguna will hit first.

8.name: Nami's Soul Cries Out! Straw Hat Luffy Makes a Comeback!
8.overview: Nami finally reaches Luffy and tells him that he needs to hurry before Robin reaches Enies Lobby. Chopper finds Zoro and hands him the Sandai Kitetsu so he can escape the chimney. Luffy pushes apart the buildings he was stuck between and Paulie grabs them all so they can escape the Aqua Laguna's massive wave.

8.name: Another Sea Train? Rocketman Charges Forth!
8.overview: Sanji fights his way through another train car and finds Usopp and Franky. Seeing how determined Luffy is to save Robin, Kokoro and Iceburg lends the Strawhat crew the use of another sea train, Rocket Man. The Franky Family shows up, pleading with Luffy to let them join them because they'll do anything for their leader.

8.name: Rescue Our Friends! A Bond Among Foes Sworn with Fists!
8.overview: The Rocket Man finally makes it out to sea. As the train connects with the tracks, Luffy has to rescue Chimney before she's thrown off by the wind. In the meanwhile, Iceburg has a flashback about when he finally met Franky again in Water Seven. With Luffy and Chimney safe in the train, Paulie tells his fellow carpenters who the real culprits were. The Strawhats, Franky Family, and Galley La Company form an alliance.

8.name: Smash the Wave! Luffy and Zoro Use the Strongest Combo!
8.overview: Luffy and Zoro perform a move that acts similar to a cannon and blasts a hole through the wall of the tidal wave ahead of them, opening up a channel for them to pass through. They miraculously pass through unscathed and the passengers rejoice. Sanji contacts the rest of the crew and fills them in on his current situation. Usopp separates from them but later, when Sanji and Franky are spotted, a man named Sogeking comes to their rescue.

8.name: A Mysterious Man Appears?! His Name Is Sogeking!
8.overview: Sogeking makes his grand entrance. Franky and Sanji aren't fooled by his costume but they try to humor him. They devise a plan first, then detach the last two cars and fight their way through the rest. Back in the Rocket Man, Luffy, Zoro, Nami, and Chopper get an outfit change; Nami shows off the weapon Usopp upgraded for her while he was still with them.

8.name: Showdown Between Cooks! Sanji vs. Ramen Kenpo
8.overview: Kalifa updates the CP9 on the situation with Franky, Sanji, and Usopp. Sanji tells Franky and Usopp to go on without him so he can fight Wanze and his "Ramen Kenpo". Franky begins to fight Nero, CP9's "Weasel", and Sogeking meets with Robin.

8.name: Rooftop Duel! Franky vs. Nero
8.overview: Franky's fight with Nero continues. Nero discovers that Franky's weak spot is his back, so Franky lies down flat so he can't get to it. Nero demands that he fight seriously, so Franky gets up to perform his "Centaur" form. Sogeking talks with Robin and tells her that the crew knows about her reasons for leaving. Those on the Rocket Man encounter the discarded cars and Zoro slices them so they can pass.

8.name: Clash! Demon-Slasher Zoro vs. Ship-Slasher T-Bone!
8.overview: Zoro clashes with "Ship Cutter" T-Bone. The fight is short and Zoro joins the crew again in the Rocket Man. On the Puffing Tom, Sanji beats Wanze beautiful, though Wanze thinks he's ruined his face. Franky finally gains the upper hand against Nero and defeats him. After beating their respective opponents, Franky and Sanji stand to fight against the other CP9.

8.name: Scramble over Robin! A Cunning Plan by Sogeking!!
8.overview: After hiding under Robin's cloak for a few episodes, Sogeking finally shows himself. They stumble into the room with the CP9 and meet with Sanji and Franky. Sogeking produces a smokescreen. The four head into another car, detach it, and escape. It's not long before Blueno pulls their car back, though. Franky knocks down the wall so they can escape but ends up on the enemy car. Blueno opens a door then back in the Strawhat car.

8.name: The Judicial Island! Full View of Enies Lobby!
8.overview: Robin willingly follows Blueno into his improvised door and Sogeking and Sanji are left alone. For a while, Blueno explains a little of Robin's past involving the Buster Call. Back at the Rocket Man, Yokuzuna the frog jumps onto the front of the train, knocking them from the rails. After Kokoro speaks with him, he joins the group. The CP9, Franky, and Robin finally reach Enies Lobby and disembark.

9.name: Landing Operations Start! Charge in, Straw Hats!
9.overview: The Straw Hats hatch a plan to rescue Robin, but as usual, Luffy can't wait to find a fight. Will his impulsive attack derail their mission?

9.name: Luffy Cuts Through! Big Showdown on the Judicial Island!
9.overview: Luffy manages to reach the main island, but the Franky Family's assault is stopped short by a couple of angry giants!

9.name: Battle Against Giants! Open the Second Gate!
9.overview: Luffy makes short work of a few hundred marines, the Franky Family takes down a giant, and the assassins of CP9 report back to Spandam!

9.name: Find a Way Out! Rocketman Takes Flight!
9.overview: Zoro's quick thinking - and a little help from a giant frog - sends the sea train soaring into the sky on a collision course with armed guards and their canine companions!

9.name: Catch Up with Luffy! The Straw Hats' All-Out Battle
9.overview: Nami electrocutes the enemy with a Clima Tact attack, but the bad guys have the Straw Hats surrounded until the Franky Family shows up with a couple of sea monsters!

9.name: Robin Betrayed! The Motive of the World Government!
9.overview: Zoro, Sanji, Nami, and Chopper try to catch up with their captain, Soge King is nowhere to be found, and Luffy runs head first into a battle with Blueno!

9.name: Give Robin Back! Luffy vs. Blueno!
9.overview: Luffy shows off his new strength in a brawl with Blueno, Soge King befriends a giant, and a hulking sea beast makes the ultimate sacrifice.

9.name: Don’t Stop! Hoist the Counterattack Signal!
9.overview: While Luffy continues his battle with Blueno, Soge King's giant companions make their presence felt, and the assassins of CP9 experiment with Devil Fruits!

9.name: Almost to Luffy! Gather at the Courthouse Plaza!
9.overview: A blind Kingbull fights with his last breath to get the Straw Hats one step closer to their captain. Luffy kick his body into second gear to protect his friends from dangerous foes!

9.name: Everything Is to Protect My Friends! Second Gear Activated!
9.overview: Luffy batters a baffled Blueno with his powerful new fighting style, and the cowardly Spandam begins to panic at the sound of the Straw Hats approaching!

9.name: Give Us Your Answer, Robin! The Straw Hats' Outcry!
9.overview: Luffy and his crew are finally reunited and ready to rescue Robin, but the raven-haired beauty remains reluctant to rejoin her former mates despite Franky's urging.

9.name: Robin's Past! The Girl was Called a Devil!
9.overview: Flash back to Robin's days as a young girl, her dangerous pursuit of forbidden knowledge, and her encounter with a friendly giant.

9.name: Fated Mother and Daughter! The Mother's Name is Olvia!
9.overview: Robin's flashback continues with the heartbreaking arrival of her mother - and the government's cruel and brutal invasion of a peaceful island!

9.name: The Tragedy of Ohara! The Terror of the Buster Call!
9.overview: Professor Clover reveals a startling and sinister theory about the World Government, Robin reunites with her mother, and a giant joins the fight!

9.name: Say You Want to Live! We Are Your Friends!!
9.overview: The painful story of Ohara - and Robin's younger years - draws to a tragic close. Luffy declares war on the World Government, and Robin finally changes her tune!

9.name: Jump Towards the Falls! Luffy’s Feelings!
9.overview: The Straw Hats are ready to begin the fight for Robin, but first, Luffy flashes back to memories of his childhood - and the man who made him want to become a pirate!

9.name: The Ways of Men! Zoro's Techniques, Usopp's Dream!
9.overview: Zoro remembers the first time he met Luffy, and Usopp recalls the events that led him to join the Straw Hats!

9.name: A Bond of Friendship Woven by Tears! Nami's World Map!
9.overview: Nami's heartbreaking past - and Luffy's epic battle with Arlong - are recalled in this flashback to the early days of the Straw Hats!

9.name: Parting Builds a Man's Character! Sanji and Chopper!
9.overview: A flashback sheds light on how Sanji came to join the crew, and Chopper's backstory is revealed through memories of a visit to a snow-covered island!

9.name: Everything Is for Her Friends! Robin in the Darkness!
9.overview: A flashback reveals Robin's motives for cooperating with CP9, Nami's shocking discovery about the archaeologist's past, and Luffy's determination to save his friend!

9.name: I'm Not Gonna Hand Over the Blueprints! Franky's Decision!
9.overview: Franky stands up to Spandam by destroying what the madman desires most, and the sound of the sea train spurs the Straw Hats to make a daring leap of faith!

9.name: Retrieve the 5 Keys! The Straw Hat Crew VS CP9
9.overview: Luffy races to rescue Robin while the rest of the Straw Hats set off in search of the five keys needed to unlock the archaeologist!

9.name: Power of the Devil Fruit! Kaku and Jabura Transform
9.overview: While Usopp and Zoro go head-to-head with a couple of animal assassins, Sanji teaches the most beautiful member of CP9 the secrets of making good tea!

9.name: I Won't Kick Even If It Costs Me My Life! Sanji's Chivalry!
9.overview: Luffy runs into trouble trying to sail his way to Robin, Usopp and Zoro end up handcuffed together, and Sanji's inability to kick a women may lead to serious injury!

9.name: Fukurou's Miscalculation! My Cola is the Water of Life!
9.overview: Chimney and Gombe show Luffy the secret passage that leads to Robin, and Franky puts on a display of raw punching power thanks to a few bottles of cola!

9.name: Zoro Busts Out a New Technique! The Sword's Name is Sniperking?
9.overview: While Franky's brawl spills into the ocean, Usopp and Sanji attempt to overcome their handcuffs by outsmarting their opponents!

9.name: Uncontrollable! Chopper's Forbidden Rumble!
9.overview: Determined not to be defeated by the heinous hair of a devious lion, Chopper risks life and limb by summoning the power of his Rumble Ball for a third time!

9.name: Boss Luffy Returns! Is It a Dream or Reality? Lottery Ruckus!
9.overview: Travel back to ancient Japan for a madcap adventure starring the Straw Hats, some old friends and enemies, and a camel that eats lottery tickets!

9.name: A Big Rice Cake Tossing Race at the Castle! Red Nose's Plot!
9.overview: The madcap throwback continues as Luffy and the gang - along with a crowd of characters from the Alabasta arc - competes for a priceless treasure hidden inside a tasty snack!

9.name: Bubble Master Kalifa! The Soap Trap Closes in on Nami!
9.overview: Nami battles a bathing beauty and her lethal bubbles, Chopper unleashes his inner beast, and Luffy inches ever closer to catching up with Robin!

9.name: Resounding Bad News! The Buster Call Invoked!
9.overview: Franky has a painful encounter with monster Chopper, and Nami gets scrubbed too clean to fight! Meanwhile, Spandam accidentally invokes the deadly Buster Call!

9.name: Five Namis? Nami Strikes Back With Mirages
9.overview: Zoro uses Usopp as a decoy in his battle with the beasts, and Nami discovers the secret that could be the key to survival in her brawl with the bathing beauty!

9.name: Nami's Decision! Fire at the Out-Of-Control Chopper!
9.overview: Franky and Nami come up with a plan to stop Chopper's rampage, but it could prove deadly to the not-so-little reindeer. Usopp and Zoro are thrilled to finally be free of each other!

9.name: Hunter Sanji Makes An Entrence? Elegy for a Lying Wolf!
9.overview: Usopp's ill-advised attempt at bravery threatens to get him killed, but a familiar foot spares the sniper's life. Luffy struggles to even strike a formidable foe, and Franky races to deliver some very important keys!

9.name: Fiery Kicks! Sanji's Full Course of Foot Techniques!
9.overview: Sanji evens the playing field in his CP9 slugfest by introducing his wolfish opponent to the burning power of the devil's leg!

9.name: Fierce Sword Attacks! Zoro vs. Kaku, Powerful Sword Fighting Showdown!
9.overview: Zoro finally lands a blow against the killer giraffe, but Luffy still can't find a way to break through against Lucci! Can Frank reach Robin before it's too late!?

9.name: Demon God Zoro! An Incarnation Of Asura Born From Fighting Spirit!
9.overview: Zoro unleashes a demonic nine sword fighting style on his giraffe opponent, Luffy buys time for Franky by ascending to second gear, and Robin refuses to give up hope of being rescued!

9.name: Spandam Frightened! The Hero on the Tower of Law!
9.overview: Spandam cruely drags Robin ever closer to the gates of justice, but the battle takes a turn for the better when the Sniper King makes a surprise appearance!

9.name: Robin Freed! Luffy vs. Lucci, Showdown Between Leaders!
9.overview: Luffy's battle with Lucci reveals the powerful secrets of the rubber man's second gear, and the Spandam's thoughtless Buster Call begins with a brutal barrage of cannon balls.

9.name: Boss Luffy is the Culprit? Track Down the Missing Great Cherry Tree!
9.overview: When an ancient tree is stolen by a madman with the power to freeze time, Luffy, Usopp, and Sanji track down the culprit in an attempt to save a village's annual festival!

9.name: I Can't Protect Anyone Unless I Win! Third Gear Activated
9.overview: Nami, Sanji, Usopp, Zoro, and company find themselves trapped in to tunnel filled with rapidly rising water. Meanwhile, Luffy musters the strength for one last stand in his battle with Lucci.

9.name: The Terrifying Past! Dark Justice and Rob Lucci
9.overview: Flashback to the dark past of Rob Lucci as the young boy learns to dispense a cold, cruel, and brutal brand of justice. Back in real time, Luffy's battle with Lucci threatens to destroy the navy fleet.

9.name: A Mysterious Mermaid Appears? As Consciousness Fades Away...
9.overview: Luffy's gigantic attack on Lucci takes a devastating toll on his body, Robin rejoins the fight, and the rest of the Straw Hats struggle to survive underwater!

9.name: Cannon Fire Sinks the Island! Franky's Lamentation!
9.overview: Thanks to a little help from what appears to be a mermaid, the Straw Hats find themselves reunited aboard an escape vessel, but the fate of Luffy and the Franky Family is yet to be determined!

9.name: Wait for Luffy! Mortal Combat on the Bridge of Hesitation!
9.overview: Luffy pushes his body to the breaking point in his battle with Lucci, and the rest of the Straw Hats try to fight off a fleet of Marines until their captain returns - if he ever does.

9.name: Fists Full of Emotion! Luffy Unleashes Gatling with All His Might!
9.overview: Luffy lies battered and badly beaten, but Usopp's desperate pleas inspire the rubber-man to mount one final, furious attack on Rob Lucci!

9.name: From the Sea, a Friend Arrives! The Straw Hats Share the Strongest Bond!
9.overview: With their leader crippled by exhaustion and their escape ship destroyed, the Straw Hats find themselves with only one treacherous option: throwing themselves into the sea!

9.name: Everyone Makes a Great Escape! The Road to Victory is for the Pirates!
9.overview: The Straw Hats are rescued by the unexpected arrival of a dear old friend, but they'll have to avoid a barrage of deadly cannonballs in order to survive!

9.name: Thank You, Merry! Snow Falls Over the Parting Sea!
9.overview: The Straw Hats bid a tearful farewell to the brave little ship that was their home for so very many adventures. Rest in peace, Merry!

9.name: Peace Interrupted! A Navy Vice Admiral with a Fist of Love!
9.overview: The Straw Hats get some much needed rest and relaxation, Franky makes a big announcement, and Vice Admiral Garp tracks down his grandson!

9.name: The Strongest Family? Luffy's Father Revealed!
9.overview: Luffy's friends are shocked to learn that his grandpa is a marine hero, but that's nothing compared to how surprised they'll be by his father's true identity!

9.name: Its Name Is The New World! The Fate of the Grand Line!
9.overview: Luffy gets the chance to catch up with his old friend Coby, Nami does some serious snooping, and Robin is paid a chilling visit from a terrifying face from her past.

9.name: Shanks Makes a Move! The Linchpin to the Reckless Era!
9.overview: Shanks visits Whitebeard with a serious request, Franky and Iceberg begin construction on a ship for the Straw Hats, and news spreads of the events at Enies Lobby.

9.name: A Girl in Search of Her Yagara! Great Search in the City of Water!
9.overview: Luffy and Chopper risk their lives to help a heartbroken young girl track down her long lost pet!

9.name: Mothers are Strong! Zoro's Hectic Household Chores!
9.overview: Zoro's day takes a turn for the crazy when his search for a new sword is derailed by a couple of meddling orphans!

9.name: Sanji's Shock! Mysterious Old Man and His Super Yummy Cooking!
9.overview: Sanji spends the day with a very old chef who teaches him the secret of packing amazing flavor into each and every dish!

9.name: Everyone Finally Has A Bounty! A Pirate Group Worth Over Six Hundred Million!
9.overview: Franky and Iceberg stay up all night on a mission to finish a new ship for the Straw Hats, but the first light of day brings troubling news!

9.name: The King of Animals that Overlooks the Sea! The Dream Ship Magnificently Completed!
9.overview: With their new ship completed, Luffy and the gang get ready to set sail, but first they'll have to steal some underpants in order to secure the services of a shipwright!

9.name: Goodbye My Dear Underlings! Franky Departs!
9.overview: A series of flashbacks to his younger days - and some painful persuasion by Robin - help Franky make the difficult decision to leave his friends and go to sea with the Straw Hats!

9.name: Departing the City of Water! Usopp Mans Up and Brings Closure to the Duel!
9.overview: Luffy and the Straw Hats are ready for their next adventure, but before they can move on they must await the return of Usopp - and avoid a barrage of cannon balls courtesy of Garp!

9.name: Wanted Posters Make It Around the World! Celebrations in Their Hometowns as the Ship Moves Forward!
9.overview: The Straw Hats' new ship gets a name, and Franky shows off some of its special features as the gang goes sky high to avoid being sunk by the marines!

9.name: The Most Heinous Power! Blackbeard's Darkness Attacks Ace!
9.overview: Ace and Blackbeard go toe-to-toe in an epic clash of Devil Fruit powers that pits fire against darkness - and threatens to destroy an entire island!

9.name: The Mysterious Band of Pirates! Sunny and the Dangerous Trap!
9.overview: After departing Water 7, the Straw Hats find a drifting ship with hungry and sick fishermen. All things seem great until the drifting fishermen have something else in mind and set a trap for the Straw Hats.

9.name: Sunny in a Pinch! Roar, Secret Superspeed Mecha!
9.overview: The Straw Hats discover that their fishermen friends are actually pirates, but Chopper refuses to abandon a very sick patient.

9.name: The Dream Sinking in the New World! The Disillusioned Pirate, Puzzle!
9.overview: The captain of the Phoenix Pirates loses his will to fight, and the Straw Hats get trapped in a field of icebergs by some figure skating bounty hunters!

9.name: The Assassins Attack! The Great Battle on Ice Begins!
9.overview: Nami and Franky take a spin in the shark sub, Usopp and Sanji have a run in with a flock of deadly penguins, and Puzzle can no longer hide the fact that he's alive!

9.name: The Staw Hat’s Hard Battles! A Pirate Soul Risking It All for the Flag!
9.overview: Robin is shocked by her encounter with an adorable bounty hunter, Franky and Nami get trapped in a frozen shark, and Luffy's quest to recapture his flag sends him sinking toward the bottom of the sea!

9.name: Hot Full Throttle! The Twin’s Magnetic Power Drawing Near!
9.overview: Luffy battles a set of magnetic twins, Sanji and Usopp fall victim to a pair of figure skating lovebirds, and Zoro has a drink with the man who stole the Straw Hat flag!

9.name: Mansion of Great Chaos! The Enraged Don and the Captured Crew!
9.overview: Robin's cola care package helps spring her friends from an icy prison, and Luffy's bold words inspire a battered and beaten pirate to keep fighting!

9.name: The Return of the Phoenix! The Dream of the Pirate Flag Sworn to a Friend!
9.overview: While Luffy continues his battle with the magnetic twins, Chopper uses a rumble ball in his battle with a hockey player - and Robin tries to recover the Straw Hat flag!

9.name: The Red Hot Decisive Battle! Luffy vs. The Scorching Don!
9.overview: Luffy battles an opponent who's too hot to handle, Robin gets attacked by a jungle, and Chopper makes a heroic dash for the Straw Hat flag!

9.name: Waiting in the New World! Farewell to the Brave Pirates!
9.overview: Luffy's red-hot battle with Papa threatens to destroy the entire icy island, and the rest of the Straw Hats need a little help from a former enemy to recover their flag!

9.name: Chopperman to the Rescue! Protect the TV Station by the Shore!
9.overview: The most adorable hero the world has ever known - Chopperman - must battle a hideously evil villain to regain control of his favorite television station!

10.name: Plunging into the Devil’s Sea! The Mysterious Skeleton Floating in the Fog!
10.overview: In search of food, the Straw Hats attempt octopus hunting before discovering a barrel in the middle of the ocean. After opening the barrel, with fireworks launched from it, the Thousand Sunny gets thrown into the foggy Florian Triangle where it encounters a ruined ship with a living skeleton on it. While the others are unnerved, Luffy boards the ship with Sanji and Nami where they find the skeleton. After the skeleton introduces himself as Brook, Luffy immediately asks him to join the crew.

10.name: The Joy of Seeing People! The Gentleman Skeleton’s True Identity!
10.overview: Onboard the Thousand Sunny, Brook tells his story of being a musician before being killed. However, his spirit was able to reanimate his skeleton due to the power of the Revive Revive Fruit. He also tells of having his shadow stolen, and thus cannot be out in open sunlight. A ghost suddenly appears in the galley, and the Straw Hats find out that they have been targeted by the ghost isle Thriller Bark, which has found them.

10.name: One Unnatural Phenomenon After the Next! Disembarking on Thriller Bark!
10.overview: Brook bids farewell to the Straw Hats and leaps overboard, revealing that the lightness of his body allows him to dash across the ocean's surface. Nami, Usopp, and Chopper sail out to explore the island using the Mini-Merry II, ending up getting knocked onto land before they are chased by a patchwork cerberus that is a third fox. Back on the ship, the remaining crew members are harassed by an invisible creature. After fleeing the cerberus, Nami, Usopp, and Chopper encounter Hildon, a vampiric creature who offers to take them to the mansion of Doctor Hogback.

10.name: The Man Called a Genius! Hogback Makes His Appearance!
10.overview: Usopp, Nami and Chopper traverse through the forest of Thriller Bark, Chopper revealing Doctor Hogback to be a famous surgeon and expressing excitement to see him. But when the group have second thoughts of heading towards Hogback's manor, due to the strange creatures roaming the wood, Hildon is nowhere to be seen before being attacked by a platoon of zombies that drive them towards the direction of the manor. While immediately hospitable, despite the manners of his female assistant Victoria Cindry, Hogback starts acting strange after it is mentioned that Brook has arrived on the island. The Thousand Sunny, meanwhile, gets caught in a giant spiderweb.

10.name: Nami’s in a Major Pinch! The Zombie Mansion and the Invisible Man!
10.overview: After the meeting with Hogback, who frightens Chopper by insisting that no one is allowed in his laboratory, Nami takes a shower with Usopp and Chopper outside while musing her thoughts on their situation. But Nami finds herself restrained by an invisible man in the shower, the figure fleeing when Usopp and Chopper manage to drive him off. The invisible man meets with Hogback and the ghost, referred as Perona, to discuss what to do with the Straw Hats. As the rest of the crew set foot on Thriller Bark, Luffy taming the cerberus as the group encounter more zombie creatures, Nami, Usopp, and Chopper attempt to leave the manor. But the trio instead find themselves surrounded by the Surprise Zombies: zombies that strike from paintings, taxidermied heads, and even floor rugs.

10.name: The Zombie’s Secret! Hogback’s Nightmarish Laboratory!
10.overview: While evading the Surprise Zombies upon finding a secret passage, Nami, Chopper and Usopp discover the truth about Victoria Cindry being a starlet who died long ago. They eventually found the door to Hogback's laboratory, observing the scientist from outside before they are found by a mysterious samurai zombie who sounds like Brook. Meanwhile, Luffy's group are ambushed by ghosts who briefly made them depressed before they reach the graveyard where they are ambushed by the zombies.

10.name: His Name is Moria! The Great Shadow-Seizing Pirate's Trap!
10.overview: After beating the zombies, the Straw Hats learn that one of the Shichibukai, Gecko Moria, has been stealing people's shadows and using them to revive zombies. After they leave, Absalom rallies the zombies together for the Night Attack, while the ghosts from before return to their master, a Gothic Lolita-style Ghost Princess Perona. Gecko Moria himself, a massive, giant-like man, is awoken. The Straw Hats come to the realization that Thriller Bark is not an island, but rather, a massive ship!

10.name: Feast of the Zombie Song! The Night Raid's Bell is the Sound of Darkness!
10.overview: Usopp, Nami and Chopper are effortlessly incapacitated by Ryuma and locked inside a coffin. Luffy and the others enter the mansion and defeat the Surprise Zombies with ease, but Sanji goes missing, so they force Oinkchuck to act as their guide by taking him with them. While the zombies of Thriller Bark celebrate the start of the Night Raid, Absalom awakens the other General Zombies to handle the Straw Hats.

10.name: A Bunch of Animals? Perona's Wonder Garden!
10.overview: After awakening the General Zombies, Absalom is accosted by Lola, a zombie warhog obsessed with making him her husband. After learning that he's chosen Nami to be his bride, Lola sets her sights on the navigator. Nami, Usopp, and Chopper manage to escape their coffin and find themselves in a garden, surrounded by animal zombies, including a bizarre penguin-bulldog zombie named Inuppe who talks and acts a lot like Sanji. The other Straw Hats, meanwhile, discover a hallway lined with suits of armor, and realize that Zoro is now missing as well.

10.name: The Vanishing Straw Hat Crew! A Mysterious Swordsman Appears!
